name: Maid to Majutsushi
source:
There is a maid, Lapis, living alone in a small town in a small country. She has been waiting for her master's return. One day, a boy, Act, visits the town to meet a magician to get back his lost memories. They meet by chance, and start to live together...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305063010/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1007227]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
在一个小国的小镇上，住着一位名叫拉碧丝的女仆。她一直在等待主人的归来。某天，一个名叫阿克特的男孩来到小镇，寻找能帮他找回失去记忆的魔法师。两人偶然相遇，开始了同居生活……
